checkpoint_snapshot: once per checkpoint id, canonical JSON, referenced by later rows
operation_index_row: reference only; does not repeat the checkpoint snapshot
distribution_record: once per checkpoint, family depth, donor policy and policy seed
crash_safe_allowance: largest single artifact coexists with the rest of the tree during atomic replace
historical_formula_bytes: n_units * 2000000 + evaluation_worlds * 200, reported and not the gate
